videos.description: Patrick decides it's time to start living life like Larry the Lobster in 'A Life In A Day', and then in 'Sun Bleached', SpongeBob tries to get a tan, with disappointing results.

videos.title: Kamp Koral
videos.description: Krabs reignites his passion for clowning in 'Krabsy the Klown', then in 'Lords of the LARP', Mo learns a new kind of fun and camaraderie.

videos.title: Kamp Koral
videos.description: SpongeBob and Patrick compete to be camp mascot in 'Mascot Mayhem', then in 'Putt Up or Shut Up', Krabs and Squidward play the most dangerous game.

videos.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
videos.description: Jeanette wants to give a toast to Brittany at her upcoming party in 'My Sister The Weirdo', then in 'Turf War', Alvin decides to borrow Brittany's baby-sitting job.

videos.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
videos.description: Dave is concerned that The Chipmunks are obsessed with a video game in 'Mystic Mountain', and in 'Candy Confessions', Alvin wants a skateboard, but Theodore uses the money to buy sweets.

videos.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
videos.description: Mr Krabs gets trapped in Bikini Bottom's brand-new bank in 'Safe Deposit Krabs', and then in 'Plankton's Pet', Plankton gets a pet to cheer himself up.

videos.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
videos.description: Plankton's giant Chum Bucket glove runs wild in 'Handemonium', then in 'Breakin', SpongeBob takes his first break ever at work, but how will he spend his precious time.

videos.title: Kamp Koral
videos.description: A secret snack experiment has monstrous side effects in 'Midnight Snack Attack', then in 'Hot Pearl-tato', Mr. Krabs needs to find a babysitter for Pearl, but she proves too much to handle.

videos.title: Kamp Koral
videos.description: An unsatisfied anchovy strays from his brothers in 'What About Meep?', then in 'Hard Time Out', SpongeBob is sent to time out on behalf of his buddy, so Patrick does what he can to help.

videos.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
videos.description: Alvin is convinced his mojo was in a cap he gave away in 'Mojo Missing', then in 'Who's The Animal', Alvin finds himself mistaken for a Tasmanian devil during a costume visit to the zoo.

videos.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
videos.description: The Chipmunks decide to find Dave a new girlfriend in 'Slippin Thru My Fingers', then in 'Driving Dave Crazy', the Chipmunks accidentally ruin Dave's new song for the music festival.

videos.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
videos.description: SpongeBob needs the help of a psychiatrist, but gets only Plankton, in 'Fear Of A Krabby Patty', and then in 'Shell Of A Man', Mr. Krabs is getting ready for a big reunion.

videos.title: SpongeBob SquarePants
videos.description: SpongeBob throws away Mr Krabs' old mattress - the one that he kept all his money in - in 'The Lost Mattress', and then in 'Krabs vs. Plankton', Plankton slips and sues The Krusty Krab for damages.

videos.title: Kamp Koral
videos.description: SpongeBob, Patrick and Sandy decide to turn their cabin into a pirate ship in 'Camp Crossbones', then in 'A Jelly Life', SpongeBob pretends to be a jellyfish for research purposes.

videos.title: Kamp Koral
videos.description: Squidward is determined for his cabin to win the annual camp art competition in 'Painting with Squidward', then in 'Kamp Kow', The Kamp Koral campers befriend a cow with a big appetite.

videos.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
videos.description: Theodore's new toy is annoying Alvin and Simon in 'Talking Teddy', then in 'Principal Interest', Alvin is none-too thrilled about going back to school, until he sees the new Principal.

videos.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
videos.description: Eleanor decides to move in with Alvin and his brothers in 'Sister Act', then in 'Lil' T', Theodore posts a video of himself rapping on the Internet and it becomes a mega-hit.
